title: 信息日报 2026-07-29

headline.title: 超越Shapley：基于影响力的数据审计管线用于大模型对齐与评估
headline.summary: 该研究提出一种基于影响力计算的数据审计方法，用于检测大模型偏好与指令微调数据中的隐藏矛盾、安全风险和标注错误，可提升模型对齐的安全性和可靠性。
headline.title_en: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
headline.summary_en: Proposes an influence-based data auditing pipeline to detect hidden contradictions, safety risks, and annotation errors in LLM preference and instruction-tuning data, improving alignment safety and reliability.
headline.original_title: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
headline.reason: 该工作为AI数据质量与模型对齐这一核心瓶颈提供了创新解决方案，实用性高且影响广泛，适合作为今日头条。
headline.reason_en: This work offers an innovative solution to the core bottleneck of data quality and model alignment, with high practical impact and broad relevance, making it the lead story.
